g.text: Base substitutions and their predicted consequences
TTN · 52 positions × 12 directed substitutions · GRCh37 chromosome 2
Colour: impact after − before, per ALT copy. Numbers: runs choosing that substitution (of 10).
Cyan: lower predicted impact. Orange: higher. Neutral: equal. Blank scored cells: never chosen.
Comparisons cover the three non-reference ALTs at each position, not reference reversion.
Colours describe consequence scores, not measured function or ClinVar eligibility.
All 20 track totals independently reproduced from 156 predicted alleles; exact values are retained as CSV.
